answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities to non-fungible cryptographic stake. Nodes forge verifiable identity trees rooted in a base deposit, where each subsequent child link in the vine incurs quadratic stake burning: total cost scales as O(n^2). Slashing burns deposits irreversibly, turning collateral into immutable marble. This superlinear cost scaling ensures attacker expenditure outpaces potential payoff.
